//: Loaded only with Survivor Minds: the dead survivor at an overrun camp (level_1/structures_story.json) also carries their journal, with its last entries already written.

One of these journals. Survivor Minds' journal item (sm_journal) reads the item variables sm_journal_owner and sm_journal_text, the same ones its NPCs fill in each morning, so a pre-written one reads like any other found journal. Mention only what an overrun squatter camp holds: sandbags, a brazier, the drip pool, wretches, the dark.
